title: Dits & Daws
tagline: Tap it. Punch it. Crack it.
teaser: Messages are arriving on machines from computing's past: a clicking telegraph, punched cards, paper tape, a printer banner, a scrambled cipher. Listen, decode, crack — and send your own. Six little Unix tools, rebuilt as a codebreaker's desk.

inspiredBy.originalTitle: caesar, rot13, morse, bcd, ppt, banner
inspiredBy.uiTitle: six Unix tools for codes and signals

manPage.synopsis: Dits & Daws — read and send messages on a telegraph, a cipher wheel, punch cards, paper tape, a banner printer and flags.
manPage.description: Six little Unix tools for codes and signals, rebuilt as a codebreaker's desk. caesar's automatic codebreaker becomes a cipher wheel with a frequency scope; morse, bcd and ppt become a telegraph, a card punch and a tape reader; Mark Horton's banner prints sideways again; and a signaller on the roof sends flag semaphore. Seven chapters, a Daily Signal and a desk for making codes of your own.

howToPlay: Messages arrive on six machines: read what they say and type it, or send them back.
Turn the cipher wheel, punch cards and tape, read banners early and set the flags in time.
Three stars a message: every letter right, inside the par time, and without hints.

packages.title: First dit
packages.description: Tap the telegraph key for one short mark.

packages.title: First daw
packages.description: Hold the key for a long mark: the old program called it a daw.

packages.title: Twenty a minute
packages.description: Key a whole message at twenty words a minute or faster, every letter right.

packages.title: Frequency sleuth
packages.description: Crack a turned message with the scope and no other help.

packages.title: Beat the machine
packages.description: Crack a message that fools the automatic codebreaker.

packages.title: Card reader
packages.description: Read a card of ten characters or more without the code chart.

packages.title: Tape weaver
packages.description: Punch a tape of eight rows or more without a slip.

packages.title: Banner day
packages.description: Read a banner before half of it has printed.

packages.title: Squint
packages.description: Read a grainy banner printed thirty-three columns wide or narrower.

packages.title: Flag reader
packages.description: Read a message of twenty letters or more from the roof.

packages.title: Flag sender
packages.description: Send a word by flag with no late or wrong letters.

packages.title: Chain reaction
packages.description: Solve a message that runs through more than one machine.

packages.title: The Signal Room
packages.description: Read every message in all seven chapters.
